faqs.question: Which database engine powers this online SQL editor?
faqs.answer: This SQL editor is powered by an in-browser SQLite WebAssembly engine. Queries run 100% locally on your computer with instantaneous performance.

faqs.question: Are sample tables and data preloaded?
faqs.answer: Yes, sample relational tables (employees, departments, orders, products) are preloaded so you can practice SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and JOIN queries immediately.

faqs.question: Can I create my own custom tables?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can run CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE queries to build and alter your own custom schemas.

faqs.question: Can I export SQL query results?
faqs.answer: Yes, query results can be viewed in responsive HTML tables and exported as CSV or JSON format with a single click.
